summary: One spawned number's animation: pop, drift, fade, then return itself to the pool.
overview: The per-instance half: pop-in scale, drift according to its motion preset, fade over the last part of its life, then hand itself back to the spawner's pool. Kept separate from the spawner so a custom prefab can be built and tested on its own.
useCases: A custom damage-number prefab with its own look.
Testing the animation without a combat scene.
Adding a motion style without touching the spawner.

gotchas.title: It returns itself to the pool
gotchas.body: Do not destroy one yourself — that removes an instance the pool still believes it owns.
